items.name: Suite Command Router
items.description: Top-level entry point for status, opportunity discovery, snapshots, earnings and maintenance.

items.name: Opportunity Finder
items.description: Search and filter the canonical opportunity catalog used by the website.

items.name: News / Intelligence Feed
items.description: Validate, browse, deduplicate, and publish timestamped source-backed news and research updates used by the website.

items.name: Intelligence Source Registry
items.description: Track approved intelligence sources, freshness SLAs, last checks, source tiers, and assigned agents.

items.name: Source Check History
items.description: Record source-state fingerprints, detect first-seen/unchanged/changed states, and generate a due/change collection report for agents.

items.name: Artifact / Evidence Inventory
items.description: Non-destructively hash and classify research artifacts/evidence, link case hints, and flag files that require provenance review before relocation.

items.name: Earnings Tracker
items.description: Record attempts and verified earnings in a persistent JSON ledger.

items.name: Opportunity Snapshot
items.description: Create timestamped snapshots of the canonical opportunity catalog. This is not a live scrape.

items.name: New Case Generator
items.description: Create a standardized research case with metadata, notes, attempts and evidence directories.

items.name: Repository Maintenance Check
items.description: Compile core tools and report repository hygiene, version drift and suspicious files.

items.name: GitHub Command Site Snapshot Exporter
items.description: Export a bounded public metadata snapshot for the connected GitHub Command Site, including canonical tools, toolsets, cases, intelligence, Agent Operations state, and repository-tree metadata.

items.name: Repo Factory Exporter
items.description: Export the reusable Repo Factory toolset into a new repository without overwriting existing files unless explicitly forced.

items.name: Catalog Link Health Checker
items.description: Inventory canonical catalog URLs and optionally perform bounded live or deterministic replay checks to detect invalid links, HTTP failures, and likely source migrations without mutating source data.

items.name: Opportunity Actionability Evaluator
items.description: Deterministically distinguish broad opportunity lifecycle labels from actual entry/submission actionability using preserved phase and deadline evidence; never infers freshness from HTTP status or mutates source data.

items.name: Opportunity Status Evidence Normalizer
items.description: Validate and preserve source-backed lifecycle, submission-status, and deadline evidence with deterministic SHA-256 provenance, selecting the newest non-conflicting evidence for direct actionability evaluation without network access or catalog mutation.

items.name: NIH Challenge Evidence Adapter
items.command: python tools/nih_challenge_evidence.py --title "NCI Office of Data Sharing Impact Prize" --id nci-ods-impact-prize --observed-at 2026-08-20T20:00:00Z --output workspace/nih-challenge-evidence.json
items.description: Acquire one named challenge status from the official NIH challenge index and emit provenance-preserving opportunity evidence; supports deterministic HTML fixtures, fails non-destructively on network/source-shape errors, and does not invent deadline times when NIH publishes only a date.

items.name: 310 BTC Password Candidate Solver
items.description: Generate the 310 BTC case's legacy hint-derived password candidates deterministically and optionally test the PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256/AES-256-CBC hypothesis against preserved OpenSSL Salted__ evidence. Listing/validation uses the standard library; decrypt mode requires pycryptodomex and remains experimental.

items.name: 310 BTC Character Region Locator
items.description: Portable replacement for the legacy root character locator. Preserves the hint-derived character/hex hypothesis, performs deterministic horizontal edge-density region analysis, supports dependency-free P2 PGM fixtures, and writes crops or JSON files only when explicitly requested.
dependencies: Pillow required for PNG/JPEG input and crop extraction; P2 PGM analysis is standard-library only
